Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: raw source for a project-local riso print
Primary request: a dense field of repeated sawtooth roof monitors viewed from a high oblique angle, with one monitor inverted to form a sheltered rain court
Scene/backdrop: only the constructed roofscape, filling the frame edge to edge
Subject: dozens of overlapping roof ridges and clerestories; one unmistakable inverted roof element creates a circular or polygonal catchment court
Style/medium: architectural relief assembled from cut drafting vellum and corrugated card, opaque monoprint ink, broad overlapping shapes, coarse tactile paper fibers, forms defined by color adjacency without drawn outlines
Composition/framing: 2:3 portrait, high oblique view, compressed depth, repeated roof modules crop off every edge, one clear spatial exception near but not exactly at center
Color palette: deep plum, signal rose, tide aqua, warm vellum; avoid dominant green
Constraints: one clean illustration, no people, no commuters, no seats, no phones, no business clothing, no copied composition, no text, no logos, no signature, no watermark, no gradients, no photorealistic lighting

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: raw source for a project-local riso print
Primary request: Create one original compressed frontal view of a modular housing facade made from many identical recessed balcony bays, with one double-height communal balcony bridging two bays and clearly breaking the rhythm.
Scene/backdrop: The facade fills the entire frame; no sky, street, ground plane, or surrounding buildings.
Subject: A dense matrix of deep balcony recesses, railings, slabs, and shadowed openings. One large connected communal terrace clearly interrupts the repeated bay pattern.
Style/medium: Architectural relief assembled from cut drafting vellum and corrugated card, opaque monoprint ink, broad overlapping shapes, coarse tactile paper fibers, forms defined by color adjacency without drawn outlines.
Composition/framing: 2:3 portrait, strict frontal elevation compressed edge to edge, modules crop at every boundary, with one strong spatial exception offset from center.
Color palette: Deep plum, signal rose, tide aqua, warm vellum. Avoid dominant green.
Constraints: One clean illustration. No people, no faces, no commuters, no seats, no phones, no business clothing, no copied composition, no text, no logos, no signature, no watermark, no gradients, no photorealistic lighting.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: raw source for a project-local riso print
Primary request: Create one clean axonometric architectural illustration of a structural hall containing a dense forest of identical rectangular columns and shallow beam bays. One broad, continuous accessibility ramp threads diagonally through several bays, bends around or displaces multiple supports, and opens a clearly readable void as the singular exception to the orthogonal repetition.
Scene/backdrop: Only the structural interior field, filling the image edge to edge; no exterior context.
Subject: Repeated identical rectangular columns and shallow beams densely packed through the frame. A single broad ramp cuts diagonally across the orthogonal field as the dominant counter-rhythm, visibly weaving through multiple bays and creating a clear void.
Style/medium: Architectural relief assembled from cut drafting vellum and corrugated card, printed with opaque monoprint ink; broad overlapping shapes, coarse tactile paper fibers, crisp planar silhouettes, and forms defined only by color adjacency without drawn outlines.
Composition/framing: 2:3 portrait orientation, high axonometric view, compressed edge-to-edge structural grid. Make the diagonal ramp unmistakable and spatially continuous from lower foreground toward upper background.
Color palette: Deep plum, signal rose, tide aqua, and warm vellum. Avoid dominant green.
Constraints: Exactly one illustration; no people, no faces, no commuters, no seats, no phones, no business clothing, no copied composition, no text, no labels, no logos, no signature, no watermark, no gradients, and no photorealistic lighting. No drawn outlines. Preserve an unmistakable architectural column-and-beam hall and a clearly accessible broad ramp.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: raw source for a project-local riso print
Primary request: Create one clean architectural illustration: a true top-down field of repeated square cistern covers and narrow orthogonal drainage joints, with one large circular rain garden interrupting the grid and gathering several visibly converging channels.
Scene/backdrop: Only the constructed ground plane, filling the frame edge to edge.
Subject: Dozens of repeated square utility/cistern covers and orthogonal drainage seams form a dense, regular field cropped on every edge. One large circular planted depression is the sole strong exception, offset from center, and multiple drainage channels visibly bend or redirect toward it.
Style/medium: Architectural relief assembled from cut drafting vellum and corrugated card, printed with opaque monoprint ink. Broad overlapping shapes, coarse tactile paper fibers, slight physical ink registration character. Define forms only through color adjacency, with no drawn outlines.
Composition/framing: 2:3 portrait orientation, true top-down plan-like view. Dense repeated grid cropped on every edge. The offset circular exception must remain immediately legible.
Color palette: Deep plum, signal rose, tide aqua, and warm vellum. Avoid dominant green. All planting must read as tide aqua rather than naturalistic green.
Constraints: Exactly one clean illustration. No people, no faces, no commuters, no seats, no phones, no business clothing. No copied composition. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signature, or watermark. No gradients. No photorealistic lighting. No perspective view. No horizon. No black linework or drawn outlines.
